data.long_meaning: Andris is a Greek name with the meaning 'man' or 'warrior'. It is derived from the Greek word 'andros', which means 'man'. In ancient Greek culture, the name Andris was given to boys who were expected to grow up to be strong and courageous men. The name Andris carries the meaning “Man, warrior” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Andris usually hope their child will grow to embody man, warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.cultural_impact: The name Andris carries a sense of strength, bravery, and masculinity in the culture it originated from, Greece. In ancient Greek society, a name like Andris was given to boys as a symbol of the warrior spirit and a reminder of their responsibility to be strong and protect their families and communities. The name carries a positive connotation of being a respected and valuable member of society.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Andris can be seen as a reminder of God's call for each person to be a warrior for good and to use their God-given strength and courage to serve others and make a positive impact on the world. The name can also be a source of inspiration for those going through difficult times or facing challenges in life, reminding them of their inner strength and resilience to overcome obstacles. Ultimately, the spiritual significance of the name Andris is about using one's God-given gifts and abilities to make a positive difference in the world and to bring glory to God.
